ITAL 121.description: Grammar and practical vocabulary necessary for fundamental communication skills.
ITAL 121.subject: ITAL
ITAL 121.title: Elementary Italian

ITAL 122.description: Practice and further development of essential listening, reading, speaking, and writing skills.
ITAL 122.subject: ITAL
ITAL 122.title: Basic Proficiency in Italian

ITAL 130.description: Accelerated development of essential listening, reading, speaking, and writing skills to obtain the Basic Proficiency Level in Italian. Credit may be received only for one of the following: ITAL 121 and ITAL 122 , or ITAL 130.
ITAL 130.subject: ITAL
ITAL 130.title: Accelerated Basic Proficiency in Italian

ITAL 221.description: Practice and rapid development of accurate skills in speaking, listening, reading and writing. Features BBC television course.
ITAL 221.subject: ITAL
ITAL 221.title: Intermediate Proficiency in Italian I

ITAL 222.description: Practice and further rapid development of accurate skills in speaking, listening, reading and writing. Features BBC television course.
ITAL 222.subject: ITAL
ITAL 222.title: Intermediate Proficiency in Italian II

ITAL 230.description: Accelerated development of intermediate level listening, reading, speaking, and writing skills in Italian. Credit may be received only for one of the following: ITAL 221 and ITAL 222 , or ITAL 230.
ITAL 230.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in ITAL 122 or ITAL 130.
ITAL 230.subject: ITAL
ITAL 230.title: Accelerated Intermediate Italian

ITAL 310.description: Oral practice with advanced protocols of Italian conversation, focusing on perfecting rhythms and tonalities, and on a clear presentation of meaning.
ITAL 310.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in ITAL 222 or ITAL 230 or by placement.
ITAL 310.subject: ITAL
ITAL 310.title: Italian Conversation

ITAL 311.description: Introduction to letter, short essay, and creative writing, and to newspaper reports and selected essays as models of self-expression.
ITAL 311.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in ITAL 222 or ITAL 230.
ITAL 311.subject: ITAL
ITAL 311.title: Writing in Italian

ITAL 330.description: Project work in the production of plays in Italian. Includes readings in and public performance of Italian theatre and related materials.
ITAL 330.subject: ITAL
ITAL 330.title: TEATROMANIA: Italian Theater Practicum

ITAL 340.description: Cultural analysis of the issues facing immigrants and their descendants in Italy, as well as the development of Italian American Culture in the United States. Through films, original texts, secondary literature, and contemporary media will be explored. Taught in English.
ITAL 340.subject: ITAL
ITAL 340.title: The Other Italians: Emigrants and Immigrants

ITAL 350.description: Intensive language practice, emphasizing oral proficiency skills and advanced conversational protocols. Classroom instruction by native speakers, extensive contact with native environment, field trips. May be repeated for credit by permission.
ITAL 350.subject: ITAL
ITAL 350.title: Advanced Italian Study Abroad

ITAL 355.description: Introductory course of Italian Literature that covers canonical authors and key literary, cultural, and historical movements in Italy from 1200-1850.
ITAL 355.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in ITAL 221, ITAL 222 or ITAL 230; ITAL 310 and ITAL 311 strongly recommended.
ITAL 355.subject: ITAL
ITAL 355.title: Survey of Italian Literature I (1200-1850)

ITAL 360.description: Survey of significant writers, works, and cultural movements in Italian Literature from 1850 to the present day.
ITAL 360.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in ITAL 221, and ITAL 222 or ITAL 230, or appropriate placement score are required as prerequisites; ITAL 310 and/or ITAL 311 strongly recommended.
ITAL 360.subject: ITAL
ITAL 360.title: Survey of Italian Literature II: 19th-21st Centuries

ITAL 398.description: Intensive study of selected literary and cinematic topics of the Italian world. May be repeated for credit as topic varies by title. Taught in English.
ITAL 398.subject: ITAL
ITAL 398.title: Selected Topics

ITAL 399.description: Contract approved by instructor, advisor and department chair is required for undergraduate students.
ITAL 399.subject: ITAL
ITAL 399.title: Independent Study

ITAL 400.description: Significant values in the Italian cultural heritage, as presented in native print and visual media.
ITAL 400.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: ITAL 310 and ITAL 311, or ITAL 350.
ITAL 400.subject: ITAL
ITAL 400.title: Contemporary Italian Civilization

ITAL 402.description: Italian Culture Course on Italian and Global Foodways as studied through the lens of climate change and sustainability.
ITAL 402.subject: ITAL
ITAL 402.title: Italian Food Culture: Adaptability and Sustainability in Italian and Global Food Systems

ITAL 404.description: Selected plays, short stories, novels and poems which characterize quality achievements by Italians, and which promote a better understanding of Italian life.
ITAL 404.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: ITAL 310 and ITAL 311, or ITAL 350.
ITAL 404.subject: ITAL
ITAL 404.title: Twentieth Century Italian Literature

ITAL 405.description: Italian love poetry, beginning with the Dolce Stil Nuovo of the late Middle Ages and ending with post-WWII avant-garde poetry.
ITAL 405.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: ITAL 310 and ITAL 311, or ITAL 350.
ITAL 405.subject: ITAL
ITAL 405.title: The Italian Love Lyric

ITAL 406.description: Selected literature from the Italian business world, such as correspondence, brochures, specialized newspapers and magazines, biographies of businessmen, prospectuses, and annual reports.
ITAL 406.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: ITAL 310, ITAL 311 and ITAL 312, or ITAL 350.
ITAL 406.subject: ITAL
ITAL 406.title: Business Readings in Italian

ITAL 407.description: Prepares students for making lengthy formal reports in Italian, both written and oral, on topics of importance for success within an Italian environment.
ITAL 407.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: ITAL 310 and ITAL 311, or ITAL 350.
ITAL 407.subject: ITAL
ITAL 407.title: Advanced Conversation and Composition

ITAL 411.description: Italian writers, focusing on the works of Dante, Petrarch, and Boccaccio, with additional selections from later authors.
ITAL 411.subject: ITAL
ITAL 411.title: Italian Literature in Translation

ITAL 412.description: Italian films of high esthetic value that present major cultural concerns of post-WWII Italians. Skills in film criticism and analysis. Films are subtitled. Taught in English.
ITAL 412.subject: ITAL
ITAL 412.title: Post-World War II Italian Cinema

ITAL 499.description: Directed independent research project, with a formal presentation and public discussion.
ITAL 499.subject: ITAL
ITAL 499.title: Senior Project

ITAL 500.description: Italian political and literary history course focusing on Machiavelli’s major publications and their meanings with regard to the cultural and political goals of the Renaissance in Italy.
ITAL 500.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in ITAL 310 or ITAL 311.
ITAL 500.subject: ITAL
ITAL 500.title: Machiavelli and Renaissance Florence

ITAL 502.description: Comparative Italian/American literature and culture course examining the differences between humoristic texts in Italian and American cultures.
ITAL 502.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in ITAL 310 or ITAL 311.
ITAL 502.subject: ITAL
ITAL 502.title: Cercasi Umore: Understanding Italy

ITAL 504.description: Italian literature seminar tracing the history of the short story from its Italian origins through the twentieth century.
ITAL 504.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in ITAL 310 or ITAL 311.
ITAL 504.subject: ITAL
ITAL 504.title: The Italian Novella

ITAL 615.description: Graduate students fulfill their foreign language reading requirement with successful completion of the course. Undergraduates may take the course as an elective only.
ITAL 615.subject: ITAL
ITAL 615.title: Intensive Readings in Italian
